name: Taintward: Clean-run SLO + error budget
description: A service-level objective for leak-free runs: the fraction of agent runs whose trace contains NO policy violation. The error budget burns on runs that leaked. Goal 99% clean runs; a breach (tainted chain reaching an egress sink) is an SLO miss.

slo.good_event: a run (trace) with zero spans where taintward.policy.violation = true

queries.title: Clean-run ratio (SLO)
queries.sql: SELECT minute, countDistinct(trace_id) AS total_runs, countDistinctIf(trace_id, hasViolation = 0) AS clean_runs, round(clean_runs / total_runs, 4) AS clean_run_ratio FROM (SELECT trace_id, minute, max(hasViolation) AS hasViolation FROM (SELECT trace_id, toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS minute, toUInt8(countIf(attributes_bool['taintward.policy.violation'] = 1) > 0) AS hasViolation FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE serviceName = 'taintward-hr-bot' GROUP BY trace_id, minute) GROUP BY trace_id, minute) GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute

queries.title: Error budget burn (bad runs per minute)
queries.sql: SELECT minute, countDistinctIf(trace_id, hasViolation = 1) AS bad_runs FROM (SELECT trace_id, toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS minute, toUInt8(countIf(attributes_bool['taintward.policy.violation'] = 1) > 0) AS hasViolation FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE serviceName = 'taintward-hr-bot' GROUP BY trace_id, minute) GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute

queries.title: Violation rate by rule (which policy rule burns the budget)
queries.sql: SELECT arrayJoin(splitByString(',', attributes_string['taintward.policy.reasons'])) AS rule, count() AS spans FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE serviceName = 'taintward-hr-bot' AND attributes_bool['taintward.policy.violation'] = 1 AND attributes_string['taintward.policy.reasons'] != '' GROUP BY rule ORDER BY spans DESC

notes: The SLO reframes privacy as a reliability target: a 'leak-free run' is the good event, a violation burns the budget. Import via signoz_create_alert MCP.
